messages:
Juno: Quick postmortem note \u2014 we had a short window where tenant endpoint handoff caused double-applies and some customers briefly lost private routing. Need a low-risk arbitration pattern.
Samir: Was this the handoff between regional cp instances?
Juno: Yes. Two controlplanes tried to apply the same desired state nearly simultaneously. One applied then the other reapplied and triggered a route flip because of timing.
Priya: Two quick defenses: (1) per-tenant ephemeral lease (TTL) so only holder can mutate routes; (2) idempotent apply by storing last-change-hash on tenant metadata.
Samir: Lease logic needs fast failover for real outages. TTL 30s with renew path sounds ok. Also add a forced-claim API for SRE with audit log.
SRE-oncall: Please add a safe manual override step in runbook: force-release lease, verify applied-by tag, then re-run reconcile. We hit this during the incident.
Priya: Implementation sketch: store lease in global DB with fields owner, expires_at, change_counter. Operators attempt CAS on lease. If CAS fails but last_change_hash == incoming_hash, we noop.
ops-bot: note: deploy request private-endpoint-operator v3.1 -> canary queued
Samir: Also add a verification state machine: desired -> pending -> applied -> verified. Only advertise route after verified to avoid transient flaps. Verification can include cloud route table read + traffic probe.
Juno: Can we rate-limit applies per-region via token bucket so leaders don't saturate cloud controlplane on bursts?
Priya: Yes — token bucket + per-tenant leader election (shard by tenant id) gives a good balance.
SRE-oncall: Metrics request: lease_acquire_failures, duplicate_apply_detected, verification_latency_ms. Page on duplicate_apply_detected for dedicated customers.
Juno: Plan: prototype lease+idempotency behind feature-flag, enable for non-dedicated in staging, run 48h, then small prod canary. I'll open PR and link runbook edits.
Priya: I'll add the DB schema and a small backfill job for change_counter. Keep the backfill idempotent and rate-limited.
Samir: I'll scope token-bucket + leader election and a short design doc.
Juno: Thanks all, will follow up in arch sync with PR link and canary metrics.
